content.short: A collection of 7777 Cadre Cats Building an Empire on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
The Cadre Cats are a collection of 7777 Cats being minted through CardaHub Smart Contract Marketplace for 50 Ada per Cat from their vending machine and website. Mint will go live on the 20th of this month at 7:00 PM UTC.

We have back end dev support coming from cyber pickle, for continued project development after our initial sellout, with a continued partnership with Cardahub for all smart contract needs.

Our mission is to create metaverse styled assets within the lore of Cadre Cats, available for holders only. We will be providing Whitelist opportunities along with special collaborations for holders only as well, stay tuned.

We have our metaverse "pizzeria" currently under construction, once it is finsished, 3-D assets will be available for entry.

We have a great team we have put together for this project, come in discord and chat with us!
